jobs.title: (Senior) People Operations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
(Senior) People Operations Manager (m/w/d)

bonial hilft Dir dabei Zeit, Geld und Papier zu sparen. Wir sind ein digitaler Werbepartner für das Offline-Business. Wir unterstützen Händler:innen in deren Marketing-Aktivitäten und helfen dabei, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen.

Würdest Du gern dazugehören und Teil des digitalen Wandels im Handel sein?

bonial ist Teil der Axel Springer SE und revolutioniert den Einzelhandel als führender "Drive to Store"-Partner in Deutschland und Frankreich. Über unsere Plattformen "kaufDA" und "MeinProspekt" in Deutschland sowie “Bonial“ in Frankreich verbinden wir täglich Millionen von Nutzer:innen mit ihren Lieblingsgeschäften und -marken – und schaffen dabei echten Mehrwert.

Wir befinden uns in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Menschen geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen.

Wenn Du Teil eines engagierten Teams sein möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels gestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Bei bonial sorgt unser People Operations Team dafür, dass sich Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während der gesamten Employee Journey auf reibungslose und mitarbeiterorientierte Prozesse verlassen können. Dabei verbinden wir operatives Anpacken mit dem Anspruch, unsere Zusammenarbeit und unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aktuell wechseln wir von Personio zu SAP HCM – ein wichtiger Schritt für unser Team und für die Art, wie wir unsere People-Prozesse gestalten. Hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Als unser:e (Mid–Senior) People Operations Manager:in übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich, begleitest die Einführung von SAP HCM und hilfst uns, den Übergang für das gesamte Team so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unseren People Business Partner:innen, Payroll sowie weiteren internen und externen Stakeholder:innen zusammen.

Die Position ist ab dem Startdatum zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich und bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte.

  • Du steuerst unsere zentralen administrativen Prozesse entlang der Employee Journey – von Verträgen und Bescheinigungen über das Abwesenheitsmanagement bis hin zu Visa-Prozessen gemeinsam mit unserer externen Agentur.

  • Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung unserer monatlichen Gehaltsabrechnung und arbeitest eng mit unserem externen Payroll-Dienstleister zusammen, damit die Abrechnung korrekt und pünktlich erfolgt.

  • Du spielst eine aktive Rolle bei unserem Wechsel zu SAP HCM und unterstützt aus People-Operations-Perspektive bei Datenqualität, Prozessgestaltung, Tests und Dokumentation.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Prozesse im Arbeitsalltag ankommen: Du teilst Wissen, unterstützt das Team und stellst einen reibungslosen Übergang sicher, ohne das Tagesgeschäft aus dem Blick zu verlieren.

  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung und setzt deine Ideen in pragmatische und nachhaltige Lösungen um.

  • Du behältst Änderungen im Arbeitsrecht und Best Practices im People-Operations-Bereich im Blick und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen für bonial ab.

  • Als Teil des Teams unterstützt Du regelmäßig unsere Bürotage und Vor-Ort-Termine, zum Beispiel Onboardings und Unterschriftentermine.



Dein Profil:

  • Du bringst umfangreiche Berufserfahrung in People Operations, HR-Administration oder einer vergleichbaren generalistischen HR-Rolle mit.

  • Du verstehst, was gute Datenqualität, verlässliche Prozesse und ein reibungsloses Tagesgeschäft brauchen – und wie diese Themen zusammenspielen.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Struktur und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch in deine Themen.

  • Du bist hands-on, lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Veränderungen gemeinsam mit dem Team zu gestalten.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholder:innen und bleibst auch bei komplexen Themen ruhig und konstruktiv.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2), sodass Du auch in unserem internationalen Umfeld sicher zusammenarbeiten kannst.

  • Du verfügst über fundierte und aktuelle Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung in der vorbereitenden Gehaltsabrechnung.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits eine HR-Systemeinführung, eine Prozessmigration oder ein vergleichbares Transformationsprojekt begleitet. Erfahrung mit SAP HCM ist ein großes Plus.

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.
Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).*

Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können.

Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.*

Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen.

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“

Als Teil der Axel Springer Gruppe orientieren wir uns zusätzlich an den Axel Springer Essentials. 

Hört sich das gut an für Dich? Wir freuen uns von Dir zu hören!

Besuche uns gerne auch auf unserer bonial_people Instagram Seite oder erfahre mehr über unsere bonial-Kultur unter bonial Medium.

*gemäß unseren aktuell gültigen Betriebsvereinbarungen

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

As a Senior Manager within our AI Safety team, you’ll lead delivery across our AI Safety portfolio, focusing on frontier model evaluations and crucial crossover work with our customers in the Government & Public Services space. This is a strategic role working alongside peers to shape the commercial delivery of our AI Safety projects in the UK

You’ll serve as the primary link between clients and our dedicated data scientists to translate cutting edge AI safety research into actionable changes as well as model red teaming and safeguard testing with labs like OpenAI and Anthropic into strategic, impactful solutions.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Developing and executing compelling proposals to grow our AI safety and governance work across a wide range of sectors.

  • Advising clients on AI safety strategy and technical implementation, acting as a trusted partner and consultant.

  • Mentoring and developing team members, aligning their responsibilities with the fast-growing and important AI safety domain.

  • Supporting wider delivery work as a Senior Manager when needed business to ensure maximum strategic flexibility and commercial impact.

 

Who we're looking for:

  • You are excited by the opportunity to join a globally leading team in the fast-growing and vital AI safety ecosystem.

  • You possess the flexibility to support broader senior manager work and embrace an entrepreneurial approach to a highly visible portfolio.

  • You thrive in ambiguous settings and demonstrate a structured approach to problem-solving and delivering high-quality, high-stakes projects.

 

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Culture and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. Signal Processing Engineer (Radar)

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

  • Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

  • Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response.

  • Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

  • Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

  • Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

  • Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

  • Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

  • Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

  • A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

  • Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Agentic Compiler Engineer
jobs.description:
Agentic Compiler Engineer

ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

You will contribute to areas such as:

  • Compiler and IR design for representing and transforming LLM computations.

  • Optimization passes, lowering, and code generation.

  • Search methods for exploring different implementations and execution strategies.

  • Verification and correctness checks for generated changes.

  • GPU execution, profiling, and performance optimization.

  • LLM inference across operators, memory, parallelism, and communication.

  • Optimization loops that connect generated changes to measurements on real GPUs.

One direction we are exploring combines an IR, a verifier, a compiler, and a search optimizer. We plan to start with focused problems, build working prototypes, and extend the system from what we learn.

Your main area will depend on your experience, skills, and interests. You may focus more on compilers, GPU systems, or LLM inference while working closely with people across the full stack.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We look for engineers with deep technical expertise and original work in at least one area relevant to AGCO.

Relevant experience includes:

  • Compiler engineering, including optimization passes, IRs, lowering, code generation, LLVM, or MLIR.

  • GPU programming with CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, or similar technologies.

  • GPU performance work involving kernels, memory, synchronization, profiling, or hardware behavior.

  • LLM inference engines and performance optimization.

  • Attention, MoE, parallelism, communication, or other systems-level parts of LLM execution.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

jobs.description:
Account Director, Client Solutions

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Client Solutions based in Switzerland.

As an Account Director, Client Solutions, you will own a portfolio of strategic client relationships from discovery through delivery, renewal, and expansion. You’ll serve as the senior commercial and strategic point of contact for executive stakeholders, helping clients turn customer data into measurable revenue growth. The role combines consulting, account leadership, commercial ownership, and project direction without requiring you to be the hands-on technical builder. You’ll work closely with architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scoped, delivered, and aligned with business objectives. With clients across Europe and North America, you’ll operate in a diverse environment spanning multiple industries, technologies, and regulatory contexts. This is a high-ownership opportunity for an experienced client leader who can connect strategy, technology, and commercial outcomes.


Accountabilities
  • Own the executive-level relationship across a portfolio of clients, acting as the primary strategic contact for senior marketing and growth stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain a strong client cadence through biweekly meetings, monthly roadmap and statement-of-work reviews, and quarterly business reviews covering results, priorities, risks, and future opportunities.
  • Keep clients proactively informed about progress, budgets, timelines, risks, and decisions, ensuring there are no unexpected developments.
  • Identify revenue opportunities across acquisition, conversion, and retention, connecting each challenge to the relevant customer pain, metric, business impact, and potential solution.
  • Build and defend growth roadmaps collaboratively with clients, using measurement frameworks, KPI definitions, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle strategies, experimentation roadmaps, and performance readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions and recommendations into clear business implications that executive stakeholders can understand and act upon.
  • Scope projects and translate client requirements into sufficiently detailed briefs for architects and engineers, while remaining accountable for the quality and business relevance of the final outcome.
  • Lead project execution through sprint cadence, board management, dependencies, risks, timelines, and critical-path oversight rather than performing the technical implementation yourself.
  • Review completed work against agreed client objectives before delivery and ensure commitments are fulfilled to the expected standard.
  • Run pre-sales discovery, qualify opportunities, develop proposals, and present scope, phasing, investment, and business cases directly to prospective clients.
  • Partner with Sales throughout qualification, discovery, and closing before taking ownership of the account during delivery.
  • Price and scope technical work with profitability and delivery feasibility in mind.
  • Own retention and expansion across your portfolio, ensuring scope changes are estimated, documented, and approved before work begins.
  • Maintain a six-month forward roadmap so future engagements can be planned and contracted before existing scopes come to an end.

    • Requirements

    • 10+ years of experience in consulting, agency, or professional services, including at least 5 years owning senior client relationships with direct revenue responsibility.
    • Fully fluent English, combined with professional working proficiency in at least one additional European language such as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
    • Strong understanding of the full marketing lifecycle, including demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, with the ability to identify where revenue is being lost between stages.
    • Solid understanding of how marketing technology supports modern marketing operations, including advertising, customer data platforms, marketing engagement, CRM, analytics, and related infrastructure.
    • Advisory-level knowledge of modern marketing and customer data technologies, with the ability to assess technology choices, understand trade-offs, evaluate how systems work together, and challenge poor technical recommendations without being responsible for configuration or coding.
    • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and data-driven approaches for improving marketing performance and returns.
    • Demonstrated success retaining and expanding client accounts, ideally supported by measurable commercial results.
    • Proven pre-sales experience covering discovery, qualification, scoping, proposal development, and presenting solutions to executive buyers.
    • Experience scoping and pricing technical work in a way that balances client value, delivery feasibility, and profitability.
    • Understanding of how European businesses purchase, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent requirements.
    • Advisory command of customer data platforms such as Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack; analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or GA4; lifecycle tools such as Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, or Iterable; warehouse and transformation technologies such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or dbt; tag management; CRM; and consent management platforms.
    • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to take responsibility for outcomes, surface blockers early, and drive issues through to resolution.
    • Excellent strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to balance client value, delivery quality, account health, and profitability.
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, particularly with senior and executive stakeholders.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities in an environment where consulting, delivery, and business development can compete for attention.
    • Experience working with clients across multiple countries or regulatory environments is a plus.
    • Experience working across both European and North American client portfolios is a plus.
    • Experience building or helping establish a regional practice is a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Flexible paid time off.
      • Flexible working hours.
      • Fully remote work environment.
      • Monthly per diem toward premium health, dental, and vision coverage where equivalent coverage is not already available.
      • Maternity and paternity leave.
      • Annual retirement contribution equivalent to 3% of salary.
      • Company-provided laptop, monitor, and remote-work equipment.
      • National holidays off.
      • Highly transparent working environment with clear visibility into business and client objectives.
      • Significant autonomy and room to develop and act on your own ideas.
      • Opportunity to own the full commercial lifecycle of client accounts, from initial discovery through renewal and expansion.
      • Exposure to a broad range of industries, technology stacks, and clients across Europe and North America.
      • Opportunity to advise clients on emerging customer data architectures, including warehouse-native approaches, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL.
      • The chance to work across the full customer data and revenue operations ecosystem rather than being tied to a single platform or vendor.

By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network.

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain.

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business.

  • As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem.
  • You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities.
  • You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems.
  • You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability.
  • You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly.
  • You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption.

  • Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus).

  • Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation.

Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries.

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

 

About the role

 

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build and scale AI-powered systems that solve unique challenges for global clients.

 

This is an opportunity to take ownership of the entire stack, turning sophisticated machine learning outputs into high-impact, production-ready solutions that drive real-world transformation.

#LI-PRIO

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Working in cross-functional teams, alongside Data Scientists and Product Managers, to deploy technically sophisticated, high-impact software.

  • Building reliable, and scalable frontend and backend architectures to enable the seamless delivery of advanced AI systems.

  • Building data pipelines and cloud infrastructure as part of wider AI systems.

  • Providing deep technical expertise to customers, helping them navigate complex requirements.

 

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess solid backend development skills in Python frameworks (such as FastAPI) and are comfortable managing the full application lifecycle.

  • You have full-stack experience and exposure to TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks like React or Vue

  • You have experience deploying software within cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP, ideally using containerisation tools like Docker.

  • You demonstrate a scientific and pragmatic mindset, testing assumptions and balancing big-picture vision with the technical details required for execution.

  • You know how to maintain a balance between rapid prototyping and long-term maintainability.

  • You thrive in autonomous, fast-paced environments where you can take full ownership of problems.

  • You are a compelling communicator who enjoys working in a team-oriented culture and has a relentless drive to learn and apply novel technologies.

 

Our Interview Process

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Commercial
jobs.description:
Account Manager, Commercial

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

The Account Management team is part of the Sales Team at Gorgias. We educate merchants on optimizing their customer experience for efficiency and personalization at scale. The focus of our team is cross-selling add-ons to our existing customer base. In this highly cross-functional role, you will be at the forefront of innovative tech solutions and your skills will be instrumental in driving revenue. You will join a team of 6 and have the chance to shape and build the team, playing a key role in launching new products.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a book of existing eCommerce accounts, focusing on expansion and upsells.

  • Drive the full sales cycle from demo to close for add-on and new product sales (average deal size: $10K–$15K ACV, typically closed in 3–5 calls).

  • Manage a high-velocity inbound pipeline, with some outbound to existing accounts.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success and Product teams to identify opportunities for automation and improved customer outcomes.

  • Use data to identify upsell opportunities and prioritize outreach effectively.

  • Ask the right pain-point questions to uncover growth potential within each account.

  • Continuously optimize your sales process to improve deal velocity and hit/exceed quota.

Who You Are

You’re a driven and data-minded seller who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You know how to balance volume with strategy, moving fast without sacrificing quality. You’re motivated by impact, love solving customer problems, and bring structure and curiosity to everything you do.

Specifically, you have:

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in a closing sales role (Account Executive or Account Manager) within SaaS or eCommerce tech.

  • A proven track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

  • Strong ability to manage a high volume of accounts, balancing multiple deals simultaneously while staying organized and efficient.

  • A knack for asking strategic, pain-based questions that uncover new opportunities and deepen customer value.

  • A data-driven mindset. You use numbers to identify trends, spot upsell potential, and measure performance.

  • Able to juggle for speed and deal velocity, you can move quickly from demo to close while maintaining consultative quality.

  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills; you know how to balance calls, sequences, and follow-ups.

  • Tech-savvy and naturally curious, able to act as a solutions consultant who speaks confidently about how Gorgias drives customer experience and revenue impact.

  • Strong communication skills with clear, engaging, and persuasive communication across written, verbal, and presentation formats.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working directly with eCommerce merchants or within a tech startup.

  • Background in running or advising online stores/brands on best practices.

Perks & Benefits:

  • 🏖️ 5-week vacation

  • 🤕 Paid sick leave (15 days)

  • 🌏 6 weeks full remote/year

  • 🧸 Paid parental leave (16 weeks)

  • 🍽️ CAD $400/month for lunch expenses (you’ll have your own Gorgias credit card)

  • 🏥 We provide private health insurance and retirement pension

  • 💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to CAD $900 to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy)

  • 📚 Get up to CAD $2600 of learning material and wellness support per year! This includes CAD 1950 for learning material (such as books, courses, and individual coaching sessions) directly linked to your job scope, as well as a CAD 650 wellness budget. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness.

  • 🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year, we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias
By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias
We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 remote-first employees (and growing!). For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI-native company where AI is integral to how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Growth organization drives Life360's subscription business, the engine that turns free usage into a paid membership and keeps that membership worth paying for, year after year. We set and evolve pricing and packaging for every Life360 membership, build features to increase the value of our subscriptions for users, manage the experimentation platform and the ML systems that personalize monetization, and own the partnerships that extend membership value. We are data-driven and focused on creating value for our subscribers by understanding their needs and wants. We are also an AI-native team: AI tooling is embedded directly into how we research, model, spec, and ship, and we expect everyone on the team to work that way.

About the Job

As Director of Product, Subscriber Value, you will be responsible for developing and executing a strategy to deliver value to our subscribers, while growing Life360’s subscriber base and subscription business.

You will develop new freemium features and improve existing ones, own the architecture and pricing of what members get for what they pay (tiers, entitlements, bundles, add-ons), and lead the portfolio of partner-powered value that complements the features we build ourselves. You will be accountable for the growth of our subscriptions and the satisfaction of members who choose to pay for one.

This is a director-level individual contributor role. You will set a strategy for one of Life360's highest-leverage surfaces, drive outcomes by working across engineering, design, analytics, ML, finance, and business development teams, and be the point person for advocating for subscriber value with the executive team and at every level of the company.

Life360 operates as an AI-native organization, and this role is expected to be a visible example of it. You will use AI throughout your workflow and help define what AI-native product management looks like on the monetization side of the business.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $201k to $294k USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $245k to $287k CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

  • Own the subscriber value strategy: define the membership portfolio architecture, including what belongs in each tier, what gets bundled, what gets unbundled, and what gets built versus partnered.
  • Drive the Subscriber Value roadmap and the development of freemium features that drive measurable value for our members.
  • Grow revenue per membership and set the framework that decides when to monetize incrementally versus deepening tier value.
  • Own premium services provided through 3rd parties, identify new opportunities and potential partners, hold partners to explicit launch and performance bars, and grow partner offerings over time to drive value for members and for the business.
  • Own pricing and packaging, including price architecture, promotional and discount strategy, and the execution of price changes across App Store, Google Play, and web billing, including building the business case and carrying it through executive approval.
  • Drive a culture of experimentation, from painted-door validation through fully-powered testing, leveraging AI and data science to provide value faster to our members.
  • Operate as an AI-native product leader: use AI to compress the path from question to decision to shipped experiment, build the reusable AI artifacts the rest of the team runs on, and help define the playbook for AI-native product management at Life360.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in consumer products, including 5+ years owning subscription monetization at scale, ideally in a business with millions of paying subscribers where you were accountable for revenue outcomes, not just feature delivery.
  • Demonstrable success in developing strategies that led to the growth of a subscription business, and in ideating and shipping features that drove measurable value for subscribers and increased their satisfaction.
  • Direct, hands-on ownership of pricing and packaging. You have shipped a price increase or a repackaging, and you can describe in detail what broke, what you did not anticipate, and what you would do differently.
  • A track record of product work enabled by commercial partnerships: you have scoped and launched revenue-share or embedded-partner integrations that increased the value of the product.
  • Deep fluency in mobile subscription mechanics, including App Store and Google Play architecture; proration and mid-cycle upgrade behavior; refund and cancellation differences across platforms; web billing; and the global regulatory landscape for subscription cancellation and disclosure.
  • Genuine unit economics fluency across lifetime value, gross margin, CAC, cohort retention curves, and contribution per member. You can build the model, stress-test someone else's, and identify opportunities for the business.
  • Strategic ownership at the Director level: you have set multi-quarter direction across a portfolio of surfaces rather than a single feature, made explicit prioritization calls under constrained capacity, and said no to good ideas with a defensible reason.
  • AI-native operator. This is a requirement, not a preference. Research synthesis, competitive teardowns, financial modeling, spec drafting, and reporting run with AI in the loop; you prototype with AI to validate ideas before spending engineering time; you are hands-on with current tooling; and you have used AI to deliver value in your products.
  • Deep empathy for families and comfort with the central tension of this role: Life360 is entrusted with families' safety, and every monetization decision either earns or erodes that trust.

AI-Native Expectations

  • Daily use: You embed AI in all your workflows and use it for real, substantive tasks, including research, analysis, drafting, prototyping, analytics and experimentation.
  • Review and accountability for AI output: AI-generated outputs get the same level of care of as any of your deliverables. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior practitioners who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage: doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high-integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High-Intensity, High-Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds create a stronger, more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences creates a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications below, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
jobs.description:
Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
What we are building

ecoplanet gives industrial companies the kind of energy management a corporate energy department would provide, without needing one of their own. We work with German Mittelstand manufacturers in plastics, metals, and food production, helping them see where their energy goes, catch problems when they happen, and act on what they find. Our platform covers meter data, consumption monitoring, efficiency analysis, compliance, and energy procurement. We're a Series A company backed by EQT Ventures and HV Capital.


Why This Role Matters

You'll be the designer on our Energy Insights team. The team owns our core entry product: 24/7 consumption monitoring, alerting, and the insights that turn load profiles into decisions a customer can act on. Your work covers the whole customer journey, from onboarding and labelling a customer's meters, to surfacing findings they can trust, to making sure they come back regularly.

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Own design for the Energy Insights product end to end: research, flows, interaction design, and polished UI
  • Redesign existing features, such as the customer cockpit, monitoring views, alerts, and findings, so energy managers can go from "something's off" to "here's what to do" quickly
  • Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts
  • Shape onboarding and labelling flows that help customers describe their meters and production so our insights improve over time
  • Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.
  • Talk to customers regularly and turn what you learn into design decisions
  • Help build and maintain a pragmatic design system that fits how we ship


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • B2B product design experience — you've designed complex software for professional users, not only consumer apps
  • A portfolio showing data-heavy, workflow-driven product work, and the reasoning behind it
  • Comfort working as a solo designer: you set your own process, make calls without waiting for sign-off, and know when "good enough to learn from" beats "perfect"
  • An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills; fluent in Figma
  • Willingness to talk to users directly and bring evidence into design discussions
  • Clear communication in English; German at a professional working level, since most of our customers operate in German and you'll need to understand their feedback directly
Nice to have:
  • Experience with industrial, manufacturing, energy, IoT, or other operational software
  • Familiarity with time-series data, dashboards, or monitoring and alerting products
  • Some front-end understanding — enough to work closely with engineers on feasibility and detail


How You’ll Grow

As the sole designer on a core product team, you'll set the design practice for Energy Insights largely on your own terms — there's no senior designer above you dictating process. You'll work closely enough with customers and engineers to see the direct consequences of your decisions, and as the product and team grow, you'll have the option to shape whether and how a design function scales beyond you.


What You Get

  • Real ownership: your designs define how industrial customers experience the product
  • Direct impact on a product that helps companies cut energy waste and costs
  • A small, senior-leaning team with short decision paths and close access to customers
  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Hybrid setup based in our Munich office, with regular in-person days alongside the team


The Application

Send us your CV and portfolio — we don't do long forms or generic cover letters. Surprise us.

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
Head of Operations

We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way.

About Bike Club

Bike Club is the easiest way to keep kids on the right sized bike. Through our subscription model, we remove the hassle of buying, outgrowing and reselling children's bikes, so families always have the right bike, right when they need it. We are a purpose led, fast-growing business built on ease, care, progress and joy - with a relentless focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling.

Purpose of the Role

The Head of Operations owns the system that runs Rainham: the plan, the standard, the data and the forward view. This is a new role, created as Rainham becomes both a refurb centre and a national distribution site from January 2027.

This is a planning, analytical and continuous improvement role first as well as a people management role. The Head of Operations will build the system the warehouse team, mechanic team and distribution team deliver against and will be ultimately accountable for whether the site performs both efficiently and effectively.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

1. Demand, capacity and forward planning

  • Own capacity planning end to end: built stock cover, inbound space, returns and disposal flow, physical site capacity as the site takes on distribution volume.
  • Build and stress test the peak plan well ahead of demand, including Christmas peak, modelling labour, space and carrier capacity against it.
  • Run rigorous what-if scenario planning: model the impact of demand shifts, supply delays, absence and carrier disruption before they happen, not after.
  • Set build volume targets from demand and the labour model that delivers them, and own whether the number lands.

2. Data, systems and reporting

  • Own data integrity across the site: build, dispatch and inventory reporting must reconcile, and any variance is investigated, not repeated.
  • Fluent in Salesforce (ideal) and confident evaluating or evolving a WMS suited to the site's needs as it scales.
  • Own the design of scanning, location and inventory status processes/workflow that the Distribution Manager and Mechanic Team execute.
  • Build the reporting the business needs to trust: no repeat of build numbers running on an unvalidated figure

3. Inventory and stock governance

  • Own inventory accuracy, cycle count governance and disposal authorisation across the site
  • Set the reorder points and supplier process for packaging and consumables for the Distribution Manager to own and execute upon.
  • Reconcile stock movements regularly and investigate variance as standard daily practice - not as a reaction to a discovered problem.

4. Performance framework and quality

  • Design and own the performance framework: what good output looks like, how it is measured, and when it is escalated
  • Design the QC gates built into both the build and despatch process, so defects are caught by design and automation where applicable.
  • Set the standard for order completeness and despatch accuracy, and firmly hold the site to it.
  • Own the formal performance management framework, including how underperformance is identified, documented and addressed

5. Continuous improvement

  • Continuous improvement is a default operating habit of this role, not a project or an initiative
  • Bring a lean methodology to daily operations: identify waste, standardise process, remove friction, on an ongoing basis
  • Apply automation and AI where it genuinely improves accuracy or throughput 6. Despatch performance
  • Single point of accountability for on-time-in-full dispatch performance to all members. The Distribution Manager owns the execution but you are accountable.

7. Team leadership

  • Lead all Site functions; the Distribution Manager, the warehouse (Goods In/Bike Wash teams), and the Mechanic Teams.
  • Set clear objectives for each line, reviewed monthly, and hold each accountable for delivery against the plan
  • Build the structure needed under each line as the site scales, including supervisory layers where a team requires one. (i.e. Mechanic supervisor)
  • Maintain and continuously improve the company’s safety management systems in alignment with OHSAS

Performance Metrics

  • OTIF despatch performance, site wide
  • Inventory accuracy and cycle count variance
  • 100% fulfilment guarantee. (if a SKU is available and not on site it must be built within 24hrs)
  • Build output against target, and build quality against standard
  • Packaging and consumables stock cover, zero stockouts.
  • Data reconciliation accuracy, build to despatch to inventory
  • Peak plan delivery against forecast
  • Continuous improvement initiatives delivered and their measured impact

Requirements

Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Proven experience running a modern, multi-function warehouse or distribution site at scale
  • Background in D2C logistics and industrial manufacturing
  • Strong quantitative and analytical ability: comfortable building and interrogating models, not just reading dashboards
  • Genuine continuous improvement or lean background, applied as a default way of working to black belt standard.
  • AI native - Fluency and experience is a must
  • Commercially and technically fluent, including confidence with Salesforce, WMS systems and warehouse automation
  • Track record of building control environments: inventory accuracy, reporting integrity, performance frameworks, where none existed before
  • Experience managing carrier relationships
  • Strong people leadership through both line managers and direct floor management Desirable
  • Experience in a circular economy or refurbishment-led operating model
  • Experience building a WMS from scratch or its continuous evolution
  • Peak season planning experience in a high SKU count, seasonal demand environment

Our Values

We look for people who live our values every day:

Ease: we make things simple for our members and for each other.

Care: we look after our customers, our colleagues and our bikes.

Progress: we keep improving, learning and raising the bar.

Joy: we help kids fall in love with cycling, and enjoy the work we do.

Benefits

🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays

💷Pension salary sacrifice

🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave

🚴Employee Discount on our bikes and Cycle to Work Scheme

Why Bike Club?

You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow.

This is a rare opportunity to build the operating system for our national refurbishment and distribution site from the ground up, shaping how Bike Club gets the right bike to every family, right when they need it.

jobs.description:
Enterprise Account Executive (UK/EU)

ABOUT NASH

Nash is last-mile delivery infrastructure. We help the world's largest retailers and commerce companies orchestrate, optimize, and manage their delivery operations. Founded in San Francisco in 2021, backed by Andreessen Horowitz and Y Combinator, Nash works with enterprise customers across North America, Europe, APAC, and the Middle East.

Our platform sits at the center of complex delivery operations: connecting carriers, optimizing routes, managing fleets, and giving operators the visibility and control they need to run delivery at scale. We're not a marketplace. We're the infrastructure layer that makes the whole system work.

Every enterprise customer presents a different operational reality. A grocery chain running same-day delivery from hundreds of stores has different constraints than a retailer consolidating three carrier networks into one. Nash doesn't sell a fixed product off a price sheet. We design and configure solutions around how each customer actually operates, then deploy with dedicated engineering and product support. The sales process is inseparable from the solution design process.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Nash has an established and growing UK and European business anchored by strategic enterprise work in the UK. The next phase is building a repeatable enterprise revenue engine across the region, and that starts with this role.

You'll own a set of named enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe's grocery, retail, convenience, pharmacy, quick commerce, and logistics sectors, and run the full sales cycle: identifying the right targets, opening doors, running discovery, shaping the solution with our product team, negotiating, and closing. This is a quota-carrying role with real support behind it, from product and engineering through to regional leadership, in a market where delivery has moved from an afterthought to core infrastructure.

Deals at Nash aren't won on features. A signed partnership here means you understood a customer's operation deeply enough to design something they couldn't build with their current stack, and you built the commercial case that made the investment obvious.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

BUILD PIPELINE FROM ZERO

Build and manage a pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities across the UK and Europe. That means identifying and prioritizing named accounts, developing a high-touch plan for each one, and running a disciplined outbound motion: strategic networking, targeted outreach, and well-prepared first meetings. Nash already works with one of the UK's leading grocery retailers. Your job is to convert that credibility into new partnerships, account by account.

RUN FULL SALES CYCLES, END TO END

Own each opportunity from first conversation to signed partnership. Each deal starts with understanding a customer's delivery operation in detail: how orders flow, which carriers run which zones, where manual workarounds mask systemic problems, what their cost structure actually looks like. From there you shape the proposal with Nash's product and engineering teams: which products apply, how they integrate with existing systems, what the deployment sequence looks like, what outcomes the customer should expect and when. Then you negotiate and close.

BUILD EXECUTIVE RELATIONSHIPS

Establish and grow C-level relationships within your named accounts. Enterprise buying in the UK and Europe runs on structured procurement as much as relationships: RFPs, security reviews, data protection assessments, pilots with defined success criteria. You know how to build champions who carry a deal through that process rather than around it. You'll also spend real time in the field, with operators as well as executives, because the people running the delivery operation day to day are the ones who tell you where the deal actually is.

RUN A DISCIPLINED PIPELINE

Maintain accurate pipeline data, deal stages, forecasts, and next steps in the CRM. Feed what you learn in the field back to product and marketing: which objections repeat, where competitors win, what the market is asking for that we don't build yet. Your deal notes shape our roadmap.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 6 months:

  • A qualified pipeline of named enterprise accounts with clear next steps and honest stage data

  • First new deals closed or in final stages

  • A documented outbound playbook for the region: messaging, sequencing, and what converts

  • Strong working relationships with Nash's product and engineering teams

First 12 months:

  • Meaningful new revenue closed against quota, with complex, high-value transactions in the mix

  • Multi-threaded executive relationships across your account set

  • A repeatable enterprise sales motion for the UK and Europe that the next hire can run

WHO YOU ARE

You have 7+ years in a full-cycle, closing sales role, with a track record of consistent quota over-achievement on complex enterprise deals, including transactions of $1M+ ARR. You've owned C-level relationships, and you're comfortable building pipeline through your own outbound rather than waiting for marketing to hand it to you.

You sell by understanding, not by pitching. When a Head of Supply Chain describes their delivery model, you listen for the constraints and trade-offs, not just the pain points. You ask the questions that uncover the real problem, and you can hold a technical conversation about integrations and deployment without handing it off.

You communicate clearly at every level, from the C-suite to the engineers scoping the integration, and you can carry a complex value story without jargon.

An existing network in UK or European retail, grocery, quick commerce, or logistics is valuable. Fluency in a major European language is a plus as we grow on the continent. A consulting or solution-engineering background is also a plus, not a prerequisite. What matters is that you've closed, repeatedly, in deals where the solution had to be designed rather than picked off a price sheet.

This role is probably not right for: Sellers who need a mature playbook, an SDR team, and marketing-sourced pipeline. The support here is real, but the motion is build-it-yourself: you find the accounts, you open them, you close them.

HOW THIS ROLE WORKS

You join a small, high-performing UK/EU team alongside a Customer Success function and regional leadership. Nash is a startup. The team is lean. You'll have significant autonomy and direct access to Nash's founders, product leaders, and engineering team. That access isn't ceremonial. You'll be in product discussions regularly, shaping what Nash builds based on what you're learning in the field.

The role is based in London, with regular travel across the UK and Europe.

The first 90 days are weighted toward account mapping, first meetings, and pipeline build. Closing follows the work.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.description:
Chief Executive Officer

What is saas.group?

The role is for a future CEO position at saas.group, tied to an upcoming acquisition in the HR tech and workforce management space. We are continuously acquiring new businesses and are building a strong talent pool of ambitious leaders who want to step into CEO roles within our portfolio. If you see yourself leading a SaaS business with us in the future, we'd love to connect.

At saas.group, we partner with ambitious leaders to transform great SaaS products into category leaders. Founded in 2017, we've built a global powerhouse of B2B SaaS companies by acquiring and scaling high-potential ventures. As a CEO within our group, you'll focus on what you do best — driving growth, building high-performing teams, and shaping product strategy — while we take the weight of administration, finance, and back-office complexity off your shoulders. With the backing of a fully remote team of 380+ colleagues across 50+ countries, you'll run your brand with the autonomy of a founder and the support of an experienced network that sets you up for long-term success.

We grow 23 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, and gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don't forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up to date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

We are looking for a CEO to lead one or more of our HR tech / workforce management SaaS brands into their next stage of growth and scale, with the potential to grow this into a multi-brand roll-up under one leader over time. As CEO, you will own the brand's P&L, strategy, growth, culture, and overall performance, driving both short-term execution and long-term strategic direction. You will work closely with our leadership team, board, and the broader saas.group community to deliver impact across go-to-market, product, operations, and finance. This role is an opportunity to shape the future of a small, highly profitable SaaS business (or cluster of businesses) within a high-growth portfolio, while having the backing, network, and resources of saas.group.

jobs.description:
Lead Product Manager

About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Data, Pricing and Roaming

What You Will Be Doing

ChargePoint is seeking a Lead Product Manager, to lead our Fleet Vertical in Europe. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for solutions serving fleet operators and commercial vehicle customers across the European market. This is an individual contributor role in which you will operate as a subject matter expert and product leader, partnering closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver outcomes at scale.

The role spans hardware, software, and services — shaping the product portfolio across charging hardware, fleet-management software, and energy management solutions for the European fleet market.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for the Fleet segment in Europe — covering trucks, buses and vans — setting vision and making pricing, packaging, and launch decisions.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and operations to align on market opportunities, business priorities, and successful product introductions.
  • Drive the hardware portfolio (including truck charging solutions) and the software platforms as a unified product experience tailored to European fleet customer needs.
  • Identify and influence strategic partnerships — including relationships with truck and bus OEMs — and provide input on build, buy, or partner decisions.
  • Track market trends and competitive offerings; interface with customers and sales teams to ensure product direction and capabilities meet fleet market needs and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Communicate complex concepts in a structured way and drive alignment across a wide array of stakeholders, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

Requirements

  • 12 years of experience in fleet electrification, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, or adjacent mobility sectors.
  • Demonstrated track record in product management, business development, corporate strategy, or service/operational leadership roles.
  • Experience working with fleet operators, commercial vehicle customers, or energy management solutions preferred, truck charging experience is a plus.
  • Intellectually curious, analytical, creative, collaborative, user-centric, and a strategic thinker who can work effectively as an individual contributor in a matrixed organization.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, structured narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Based in Europe; familiarity with the European EV regulatory environment and fleet market dynamics strongly preferred.

Location

Europe

Obsidian Security is a global leader in cyber security protecting the SaaS and non-human identity layer modern enterprises run on — from Salesforce and Snowflake to the AI agents now deployed inside them. The Obsidian Security platform gives unified visibility into every human and machine identity, app, and integration across their SaaS estate, detects identity-based and supply chain attacks in real time, and enforces least-privilege access before it's exploited. Trusted by major Fortune 500 companies T-Mobile, Workday, Snowflake, and S&P Global, Obsidian ranked No. 95 on the 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™, growing nearly 1000% from 2021–2024 — helping CISOs turn an unmonitored attack surface into one they can govern with confidence. Obsidian has also been recognized by Forbes as America's Best Startup Employers in 2026.

In August 2026, Obsidian raised $85 million in Series D financing led by Crescent Cove Advisors, with participation from existing investors including Greylock Partners, Menlo Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, IVP, Wing Ventures, and GV — pushing Obsidian's valuation to $1.1 billion, crossing into unicorn status. Obsidian is using the funding to deepen its R&D in agentic AI security and extend its platform as the standard for governing what AI agents can access and do inside third-party applications.

With global momentum, a growing partner ecosystem including SentinelOne, Databricks, and Google Cloud, and fresh capital from its Series D behind it, Obsidian is scaling rapidly toward long-term growth and IPO readiness.
